instruction: Go to the Apple layout guidelines and copy the 'Grid System' section content. Create a new document on the desktop named 'layout_guide.docx' and paste the content into it.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Apple layout guidelines, extracting Grid System section, and saving to docx. Evaluator checks document structure with partial credit: 0.2 for content exists, 0.2 for >= 2 paragraphs, 0.2 for >= 30 words, and 0.4 for Grid System/Apple-related keywords (0.4 for both keyword groups, 0.2 for one group).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.2 for content exists, 0.2 for min paragraphs, 0.2 for min words, 0.4 for Grid System/Apple-related keywords

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies semantic content through keyword-based validation
Metric checks for Grid System keywords (grid, layout, column, margin, spacing, alignment) AND Apple-related keywords (apple, ios, macos, human interface, hig, guideline, design)
Partial credit scoring is logical: 0.2 for content exists, 0.2 for min paragraphs, 0.2 for min words, 0.4 for keyword groups (0.4 both groups, 0.2 one group)
Getter correctly extracts full text content from docx file for semantic analysis
Postconfig appropriately saves file before evaluation
The evaluator CAN distinguish between correct content and random text - random text would not contain both Grid System AND Apple-related keywords
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: Consider requiring multiple keywords from each group rather than just one to strengthen verification
